text: That afternoon: Holmes taps the safe and asks what is in it
why: Holmes taps the safe and asks about it in ¶159, during the afternoon visit (he greets Miss Stoner with 'Good-afternoon' in ¶125).

text: What is really kept in the iron safe in Dr. Roylott's room?
why: Holmes has just asked what is in the safe, so this is a plain question the story raises; the wording does not point at an answer.

text: What is really kept in the iron safe in Dr. Roylott's room? — drugs or poisons
why: A reasonable guess: Roylott is a doctor, poison was raised as a cause of Julia's death in ¶57, and the label offers it only as a possibility.
